title: Sensitivity and specificity of MR diagnostics of the frozen shoulder in radiological routine
summary: The frozen shoulder is an often overlooked diagnosis both clinically and radiologically. The aim of this study is therefore to analyze the dependence of the correct diagnosis in MR imaging on the level of experience of the examiner.
conditions: Stiffness of joint, not elsewhere classified

interventions.name: Patients with native and contrast-enhanced MRI imaging of a shoulder joint between Jan2019 and Dec2019 at the Radiological Center Munich are retrospectively evaluated.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
already carried out native and contrast medium-supported examinations of the shoulder
Exclusion criteria:
- after shoulder surgery, especially full or partial joint replacement
- Joint Arthrography
